hero: A local repair garage interior: a car raised on a two-post lift, a rolling tool chest and a tidy tool wall; through a high window, boreal forest and a mine headframe far away in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#2f2516), accent highlights (#fffbc2), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
